Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Drummond
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 353 as introduced will decrease sales and use tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund and local funds by an undetermined amount by exempting the Blessing Angels Gifting Tree from paying state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education

Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Drummond
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 353 as introduced exempts Blessing Angels Gifting Tree from paying any state, county and municipal sales and use taxes which will decrease receipts to the following funds by the following estimated annual amounts, based on information provided by the entity:
Education Trust Fund
($1,136)
County Funds
($426)
Municipal Fund
($1,420)
Total
($2,982)
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
